categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies socket configuration for inbound P2P connections to ensure non-blocking behavior.
categories.rationale: Hardens inbound P2P sockets against potential stalling attacks as a defense-in-depth measure. Existing send and recv calls already mitigate this on POSIX systems by passing MSG_DONTWAIT, so this does not fix an active bug, but it eliminates a hazard where a missed per-call flag could allow a peer to stall I/O indefinitely.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Network socket acceptance and HTTP server socket options belong to networking and RPC/HTTP rather than shared utility libraries.
categories.rationale: Does not touch shared utilities, argument handling, logging, serialization, or subtrees.
